title: Plan a move off a legacy system
summary: Replacing an old system all at once is risky. Move piece by piece, delivering value along the way.

beginner: List what the old system does, including hidden jobs nobody mentions.
Find out who depends on it and what data it holds.
Split the move into small pieces you can switch over one at a time.
Start with a piece that is valuable and low risk.
Plan how data will move and how you will switch back if needed.
Agree when the old system will be switched off.
experienced: Use an incremental replacement pattern rather than a big-bang rewrite.
Deliver new value alongside migration to keep support.
Manage the cost of running both systems.

toolExamples.miro: Map legacy functions and plan which moves first.
toolExamples.jira: Track each migration slice as an epic.

pitfalls: Never switching the old system off
